entries.applies_to: scripts/allocation_forward_test_preregistered.py (frozen bars I1-I5); measurement convention only, no bar or threshold changes
entries.rule: For each US trading day the live NAV is the LAST /api/live/portfolio-history snapshot at or after 16:00 America/New_York that day; days with no such snapshot are excluded and listed, never interpolated.
entries.initial_nav_basis: post_fill_equity 97912.36 (starting_state_after_fills); no pre_fill_nav was recorded, so I1/I2 for the first window carry an entry-cost offset, stated in every monitor output
entries.monitor_role: alert only; any halt is the owner's decision, never automatic (OD-19)
